issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares numberOfTutors as type int, but the solution implementation uses a short for the numberOfTutors field and for the constructor/setter parameter. This creates a type mismatch with the specification and may confuse students about the expected attribute type and method signatures (constructor and setter). Students following the UML will likely implement numberOfTutors as int, whereas the solution uses short which changes the expected parameter types and field type.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the types across artifacts. Change the solution to declare numberOfTutors as int (update the field, constructor parameter, and setter parameter to int) so it matches the UML and problem statement. Alternatively, if short is intentional, update the problem statement UML and textual description to specify short for numberOfTutors so all artifacts are consistent.
